page.layout: One text column, full width, with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac headwords and Latin glosses; running head at the top with page number at the left. Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: עַמְמַיָּא גְּנִיסַת Omnes familiae populorum, Pf.22.28.
גְּנוֹסָר, גְּנִיסָר Genesar, nomen proprium terrae, & lacus prope Capernaum.
גְּנַף Ch. Ala, Idem quod גַּנְפָּא, & גַּרְפָּא. Plural. cum Aff. גַּנְפּוֹהִי Alas suas, Mich.1.16. R. Sal. legit גַּרְפּוֹהִי.
גַּסַּס Aphel אַגִּיס Chal. Elevari, extolli, elatus fieri, Deut.17.20. Item Crassum reddere, Lev.7.9. in Jon.
גַּם Ch. Elatus, superbus. Plur. גַּסִּין, גַּסֵּי.
גַּסְסִין Tela, Jacula, vel Lanceę, Hastae, 2.Sam.18.14. Itē Latera, Jef.60.4.
גּוֹסְפָּן גַּסָּף Ch. Sella, Sedile, ut Judaei communiter explicant: Guido putat esse Rhedae vel currus genus. Plur. גּוֹסְפָּנִין, Jesa.10.13.
נַעֲא Ch. Clamare, vociferari, mugire, boare, 1.Sam. 6.12. & 2.5. Hinc Syr. Imper. ܢܥܐ Et clama, ad Galat.4.27.
ܢܥܐ Syr. Clamor, vociferatio, ad Heb.5.7. Jac.5.4.
נַעַל Ithpehal אִתְנְעַל, & per Syncopam אֲנַעַל Inquinari, pollui, Jesa.1.6. Aphel Commendare, Deponere in fide alicujus. Ethpah: Commissum, depositum est, Lucae 12.48. 1.ad Tim. 6. 20.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew words are rendered approximately; the Syriac and some vocalised forms in the scan are hard to read exactly. Marginal reference marks in the text were not clearly legible.
